attr.title: Limbo
attr.desc: Monochrome puzzle-platformer from Playdead. A boy wakes alone in a forest and must solve his way through it and a derelict, industrial world beyond, guided by nothing but silhouette, shadow and atmosphere. No dialogue, no HUD, just physics puzzles, traps, and a signature grain-and-fog visual style.
attr.inst:
- Purchase Limbo (Mobile) on the Epic Games Store (store.epicgames.com/p/limbo-mobile-android-300111?lang=en-US) (Play Store version WILL NOT work!)and install it on an Android device.
- Extract the installed APK (single APK, no split install, any APK extractor or adb pull works).
- Use 7zip to unzip the .apk file. 
- Copy the whole assets/ and lib/ folders into ports/limbo/.
- Run Limbo.
attr.inst_md:
*  Purchase Limbo (Mobile) on the [Epic Games Store](https://store.epicgames.com/p/limbo-mobile-android-300111?lang=en-US) (Play Store version WILL NOT work!) and install it on an Android device.
* Extract the installed APK (single APK, no split install — any APK extractor or `adb pull` works).
* Use 7zip to unzip the .apk file. 
* Copy the whole `assets/` and `lib/` folders into `ports/limbo/`.
* Run Limbo.
